PluginData.Tooltip: Direct camera panoramas, raster displays and scoped hologram mouse interaction for HDR API.
PluginData.Author: Leo
PluginData.Description: HDR Client Renderer 0.9.13 adds a scoped on-foot mouse provider for HDR API 0.9.9 interactive controls. Native Use enters a transparent input screen; confirmed routing enables clicks and dragging, with cancellation and release cleanup. Camera, raster and portal rendering remain compatible with HDR API 0.9.6 and later.
